name: DXY-weak macro-regime composite gates broad crypto momentum
rationale: Belt-and-suspenders macro arming: require BOTH the broad macro_regime composite to flip risk-on AND the dollar to be weakening, then ride medium-term momentum across the full major+alt basket. Thesis: the dollar is the single most important cross-asset channel into crypto, so even after a broad regime composite turns risk-on, the dollar's own direction carries orthogonal information about follow-through. Both macro_regime and dxy are drifting -> read ONLY as crosses (macro_regime cross_up to flip risk-on, dxy cross_down to confirm the dollar tailwind). DISCONFIRMER: a macro_regime-cross_up-only control (no explicit dollar leg) must NOT match — if the composite already prices the dollar, dxy is redundant and this is a STOP. CONTROL EXITS: either macro_regime cross_down (regime risk-off) or dxy cross_up (dollar bid) disarms.
catalyst: macro_regime composite flips risk-on AND the dollar is weakening — confirmed broad risk-on
